About the shop

A Roslindale barbershop built on regulars, not gimmicks.

Moreno Fama has built its name the old way — word of mouth from neighbors on Washington St. Guests come back for the atmosphere as much as the cut, and the staff take the time to get your hair actually right instead of rushing you out the chair.

Friendly, unhurried service

Guests consistently point to the staff and atmosphere as the reason they return.

Rooted in the neighborhood

A short walk on Washington St in Roslindale, easy to find and easy to become a regular at.

Cuts, fades, and everything in between.
